data.body: Progress update: implemented and pushed Gerrit change 2602. Plan-review was re-run after including the directly-coupled freed-ID heldout file and passed. Targeted tests pass (38 passed); lint and typecheck pass. Full local `make test` is too long serially for this leaf session, but a local xdist run only failed unrelated timeout-budget tests because xdist leaked into nested timeout assertions; the ticket-targeted suite is green. Gerrit PS2 and PS3 got LLM-Review +1; Verified is currently -1 because Ubuntu py3.11/py3.13 both report only an xdist worker crash in unrelated tests/e2e/test_editor_e2e.py::test_emitted_bpmn_has_no_illegal_ids, no assertion/traceback, while Ubuntu py3.12 and macOS py3.13 passed. I verified that e2e test passes locally both direct and with xdist. Continuing with CI recheck as an environmental worker-crash failure, not changing unrelated editor code.
